name: Onbelt Ballantine
original_name: オンベルト・バランタイン
source:
"Good. Now, let me give you a lecture."

An academy instructor and senior member of the Holy Church. His unmatched expertise in magic and fairies has made him the most renowned "Wizard" of his generation. Yet he's also remarkably virtuous—perhaps the most devout person you'll find. 

He takes his teaching role to heart and, surprisingly, has a genuine fondness for children and looks after them well. The only problem is he tends to get carried away with his lectures, often oblivious to whether his audience is keeping up or has had enough.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.ensemble-game.com/30.kyokumari/character_11_onbelt.html]official website[/url]]
